interactions.speaker: Echo
dialogues: The crystal becomes a worn rosary.
Many Filipino families begin uncertain journeys with prayer, placing hope in faith before taking their first step.

interactions.speaker: Echo
dialogues: These beads have witnessed countless whispered prayers.
Faith did not calm the waves—it gave people the strength to face them.

interactions.speaker: Vino
dialogues: Someone held this tightly before sailing.
Sometimes the strongest anchor is not made of iron, but of faith.
